questions.question: When the scribes and Pharisees asked Jesus what to do about a woman caught in adultery, why were they really asking?

answers.text: To test Him and find a reason to accuse Him
To learn from Him what the Law means
To show the whole crowd they respect Him

questions.question: When religious leaders brought Jesus a woman caught in adultery, who did He say should throw the first stone?

answers.text: Whoever among them is without sin
Whoever caught her in the act
Whoever knows the Law the best

questions.question: After Jesus answered the men accusing a woman caught in adultery, what did they begin to do one by one?
When Jesus was left alone with the woman caught in adultery, what did He tell her?

answers.text: He did not condemn her and told her to sin no more
He condemned her but let her go back home
He told her to offer a sacrifice for her sin
